# Run pipeline and save pipeline logs (ideal final run)
- Re-runs all pipeline
- Prints log with all warnings
```{r}
targets::tar_destroy(ask = FALSE)
targets::tar_make(
  callr_arguments = list(
    stdout = "pipeline_log.txt",
    stderr = "pipeline_log.txt"
  )
)
```



# --------------------------------
# TEST Biomass component integrity
# --------------------------------

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr) # if you plan to uncomment the filter

df_diff <- tar_read(validation_biomass_sums) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DiffAbs)) %>%
    mutate(
    SimName = str_extract(SimulationName, "^.*?(2024|2025)"),
    GroupInfo = if_else(DiffAbs != 0, "Error", "Correct")
  )

# 1. Find the absolute maximum value across both columns so the axes match perfectly
max_val <- max(c(df_diff$Wheat.AboveGround.Wt, df_diff$Comp_Sum), na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Build the ggplot
p <- df_diff %>% 
  #filter(str_detect(SimulationName, "Big")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Wheat.AboveGround.Wt, y = Comp_Sum, colour = SimulationName, shape=GroupInfo)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  # Force both axes to start at 0 and end at the exact same max value
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max_val)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max_val)) +
  # Force a square aspect ratio in standard ggplot
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

# 3. Convert to interactive graph and enforce the 1:1 ratio in Plotly
ggplotly(p) %>% 
  layout(
    # scaleanchor ties the y-axis scale to the x-axis scale
    yaxis = list(scaleanchor = "x", scaleratio = 1),
    xaxis = list(constrain = "domain")
  )
```
